info.title: ReleaseNotes Universal API
info.description: Create, publish, and share product release notes and changelogs

post.description: Creates a new notes feed item in ReleaseNotes.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

projectId.description: The numeric Project ID shown in ReleaseNotes URLs like /manage/project/1234/releases/4321.

notes.description: The note content to append to the project's notes feed.
notes.example: Released a small dashboard performance improvement and filter fix.

title.description: Optional title for the notes feed item.

externalId.description: Optional external identifier for idempotent note appends.

externalLink.description: Optional URL to associate with the notes feed item.

attribution.description: Optional attribution text shown with the notes feed item.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

post.description: Creates or updates a release in ReleaseNotes.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

projectId.description: The numeric Project ID shown in ReleaseNotes URLs like /manage/project/1234/releases/4321.

title.description: The release title shown to end users.

description.description: The main body content for the release.
description.example: We shipped a small set of dashboard improvements to make daily work faster.

externalId.description: Optional external identifier. If it matches an existing release, ReleaseNotes updates that release instead of creating a new one.

featuredImage.description: Optional featured image URL for the release.

type.description: Optional release type. The docs list update, bugfix, and feature.

owner.description: Optional owner email address for the release.

status.description: Optional publication status. The docs list published and pending.

private.description: Optional boolean that controls whether the release is private.

releasedAt.description: Optional release timestamp using the provider format YYYY-MM-DD h:m:i.
